physical.title: smoking-pipe
physical.summary:
Slip catalogue:
Pipe with straight thin bamboo stem and bowl of black earthenware. The bowl is slightly bell-shaped and rises at right angles from its neck or socket which also expands towards the stem and is of circular section. The bowl is faceted all round by very deep incision so that it appears to have three bands of deeply cut lozenge design. Below the bowl are transverse bands of incised lines enclosing three bands of shallow incised herringbone pattern. Beneath the neck or socket is a perforated projection through which passes a string attaching bowl to stem.
